name: @goodandready/dsh-russian-lang
description: Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.1.5-rc.1+) web UI: adds Русский as the native language option in Settings - General - Language. 100.0% coverage across 5688 keys (1225 core UI keys + 4463 keys across 40+ ecosystem plugins) with zero machine drafts. Features unified dsh-clinebot visual design standard for Settings Card, Smart Russian UX (localized Markdown export, turn translation, live typography, slash command aliases, Alt+L layout fix), expanded error humanizer (POSIX, HTTP 4xx/5xx), Skin Center & Wallpaper Engine support, Workshop market integration, sidebar previewers, and runtime snapshot extension without modifying core files.

scripts.check: python3 tools/lint_translations.py && python3 check-coverage.py && python3 tools/term_check.py --ci
scripts.test: node --test test/*.mjs && node test/_repro.cjs && python3 test/test_tools.py && python3 test/test_extract.py && python3 test/test_overflow.py
